dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Mommy said that kids can't go on long trips, and forbade me from going with Daddy to Petrichor... Am I being too good a kid?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I'm Anaka! Do you play music well? I love all things music!

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Daddy's an awesome, awesome scholar, and music's part of his research!

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: He says that he'll bring me back a gift from Petrichor... Although what I really wanted was to go out there with him...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Petrichor?

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Petrichor's on the other side of this sea, and it's a town full of "music." I'd so love to go there, even if it was only in my dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Daddy took the boat over to that town, and Uncle Giustino also took a boat to come over here.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I'm the only one bumming about here. Gah, it's so boring...

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Uncle Giustino's told me that kids in Fontaine can ride an aquabus and even listen to music beneath the waves. Is it true?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should always listen to your Mom.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: ...Alright. Ah, if only I could wake up tomorrow and be old enough to travel already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, but...

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Ah, Mommy also does that a lot! Y'know, starting the second half of her sentence with "but."

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I wish I could tell her that you can mess with kids... but only up to a point.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Giustino sometimes tells fibs too.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Oh, so you know him too? Has he tricked you, then?

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think he was a fibber... He seems like a good person to me.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I guess there's just a whole bunch of things in this world that we kids don't get.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Still, why would Uncle Giustino have come over here if Petrichor was so awesome...?
